chapter: Hippolyte Charles, the bass and other bands
title: Sonny Henry and Albert Glenny in Hippolyte Charles's reading band
summary: Dawson says Sonny Henry played in Charles's band and called him G7, Albert Glenny was on bass, and he himself played banjo reading parts the leader handed out.
